## Change and reason

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and affected apps/packages.

## Verification

List commands actually run and results. Identify checks not run and why.
For UI changes include the relevant visual/keyboard evidence; for permissions include denied-access cases.

## Decisions and delivery

Link an ADR if this changes a durable architectural choice; otherwise write “Not needed” with a short reason.
For runtime changes, describe deployment, migration compatibility, and rollback. For docs-only changes, mark these not applicable.
